lesson_intro.ren_voice: Naan Ren. Access Denied and leak tickets land on Ops first. Mental model: Identity policy + bucket policy + BPA — all three matter. Naan demonstrate panren, neenga practice. Least privilege and Region — non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Access Control and Incidents
• Identity policy + bucket policy + BPA — all three matter.
• Mistake: Widening bucket policy to * to 'unblock' a ticket.
• Habit: Reproduce with the principal's identity — then tighten, never *.

check.voice: Why is Principal * on a bucket policy dangerous?
check.response_if_correct: It can open access far beyond the ticket — blast radius.
check.response_if_incorrect: Wildcard principal = potential public or cross-account blast.
